sources.title: Gemma 4 E4B Uncensored HauhauCS Aggressive — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A fine-tuned variant of Gemma 4 with censorship filters deliberately removed and aggressive uncensoring applied by HauhauCS. It responds more freely to sensitive or edgy prompts that standard models would decline, making it noticeably less cautious in tone and content. The trade-off is that safety guardrails are intentionally weakened, so outputs can be raw, unfiltered, and potentially harmful ...
